title: English Practice Quiz 0900
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence: The equipment ___ in the locked room.
questions.explanation: is stored is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: She has worked here ___ 2021.
questions.explanation: since is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: The files ___ checked yesterday.
questions.explanation: were is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Neither the supervisor nor the guards ___ available.
questions.explanation: are is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Choose the correct unreal past conditional.
options: If I would know, I called you.
If I had known, I would have called you.
If I knew yesterday, I will call.
If I had know, I call you.
questions.explanation: If I had known, I would have called you. is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: The report, along with the photographs, ___ ready.
questions.explanation: is is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: There are ___ errors in this version than in the previous one.
questions.explanation: fewer is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: The manager asked whether the forms ___.
questions.explanation: had been submitted is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: Choose the correct indirect question.
options: Please let me know when does the delivery arrive.
Please let me know when the delivery arrives.
Please let me know when delivery arrive.
Please let me know when arrives the delivery.
questions.explanation: Please let me know when the delivery arrives. is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: By this time tomorrow, we ___ the audit.
questions.explanation: will have completed is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.
